_about: Approved fixes to single headings, applied before the general heading rule in scripts/migrate-wordpress.ts. Each entry names the exact heading text (trimmed) and its WordPress level; `to` is a new level, or "paragraph" = the heading becomes a bold paragraph with the same text (its WordPress anchor is then not expected by --verify). The run stops if an entry no longer matches exactly one heading.

3346.reason: An h3 among its siblings «مثال 1، 2، 4» (h5): an entry error.

2010.reason: The only heading among its sibling steps «الخطوة 1–4» (bold paragraphs): an entry error. Approved 2026-11-10.
